title: DevAI-Hub Codebase Report
subtitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation of DevAI-Hub’s Capabilities, Architectural Patterns, and Deployment Systems
author: DevAI-Hub Agent
purpose: This report provides a detailed analysis of the DevAI-Hub codebase, facilitating understanding for onboarding, technical review, and deployment of AI-assisted development workflows.
executive_summary: DevAI-Hub is a production-grade configuration hub designed to upgrade generic AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, Codex, Copilot) into 'Senior Engineer' level partners. It acts as a central repository for system instructions ('Brain'), autonomous skills ('Hands'), and workflow definitions. The system encompasses robust installation scripts for cross-platform deployment, a vast catalog of over 60 skills, and templates for various development environments.

components.name: Skill Catalog
components.description: A comprehensive library of autonomous capabilities for AI agents.
components.details: Located in `catalog/skills/`, this component contains over 60 specialized skills. These skills enable specific autonomous behaviors such as 'Trend Research', 'Code Review', 'Test Generation', and 'Compliance Checking'. They are structured to be easily injected into agent configurations.

components.name: System Instructions (Templates)
components.description: Core behavioral definitions and role-playing prompts for different AI models.
components.details: Found in `templates/ai-instructions/`, these markdown files define the 'persona' and operational rules for agents. Notable templates include `CLAUDE.md` for Anthropic's Claude, `GEMINI.md` for Google's Gemini, and `copilot-instructions.md` for GitHub Copilot. They transform generic model behavior into specialized engineering roles.

components.name: Infrastructure & Tools
components.description: Utilities for management, deployment, and content generation.
components.details: The `infrastructure/` and `scripts/` directories house essential tools. Key scripts include `installer.ps1` and `installer.sh` for seamless setup across Windows, macOS, and Linux. The `scripts/generate_report.py` tool automates documentation by analyzing the codebase and producing professional reports in DOCX and Markdown formats.

components.name: Command Interface
components.description: User-defined commands that map to complex workflows.
components.details: Located in `catalog/commands/`, these define slash-commands (e.g., `/analyze-codebase`, `/generate-tests`) that trigger multi-step agent workflows. This layer bridges the gap between simple chat interactions and complex background processes.

user_manual:
1. **Installation**: 
   - **Windows**: Run `scripts/installer.ps1` or double-click `install.bat`.
   - **Mac/Linux**: Execute `./install.sh`.
   - Follow the interactive prompts to select your target project and install global skills.

2. **Configuration**:
   - Copy desired instruction templates from `templates/` to your project root (e.g., `.claude/CLAUDE.md` or `.github/copilot-instructions.md`).
   - Customize the instructions to match your team's coding standards.

3. **Usage**:
   - Use installed slash commands (e.g., `/help`, `/review`) in your AI chat interface to trigger specialized behaviors.
   - Refer to `guides/` for advanced skill usage and customization.
issues: Ensure Python environment has `python-docx` installed for report generation.
Verify file permission execution policies on Windows (PowerShell) and Linux/Mac (chmod +x) for installers.
Regularly update the local catalog from the upstream repository to receive new skills and fixes.
